objects.name: Detection technique coverage: m365-copilot-non-compliant-devices-accessing-m365-copilot
objects.description: Detects M365 Copilot access from non-compliant or unmanaged devices that violate corporate security policies, indicating potential shadow IT usage, BYOD policy violations, or compromised endpoint access. The detection filters M365 Copilot Graph API events where deviceDetail.isCompliant=false or deviceDetail.isManaged=false, then aggregates by user, operating system, and browser to calculate metrics including event counts, unique IPs and locations, and compliance/management status over time.
